title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 13.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an unauthenticated user to read restricted job artifact data due to missing authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
